== Theed Palace printing and gallery image ==
The earlier [[Special:PermanentLink/191526|page revision]] documented the unmarked [[:File:Theed-L-protontorpedoes.gif|Players Committee gallery image]]. The original and that image have identical printed attributes and game text. Both specify an N-1 starfighter and give the Bravo Fighter bonus. The [https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=124 2023 Advanced Rulebook Appendix A, PDF page 124] entry changes the separately printed [[Proton Torpedoes (Errata)|Premiere weapon]], which lists X-wing, Y-wing and B-wing instead. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=124 Internet Archive]. The gallery image remains linked on the Theed Palace card article. Both existing Theed Palace numeric routes lead to that article.
